landing.title: Turn your lecture notes into a study website.
landing.lead: Upload slides or notes. In a few minutes you get a site with clear explanations, quizzes, practice and interactive exercises — built only from your material.
landing.how1Text: PDF, text or Markdown. Files are read in your browser; only their text is sent.
landing.how2Text: Rename or remove lectures before anything is written.
